metadata.technology: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe (with MCU + radio)
metadata.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe with integrated microcontroller unit (MCU) and radio transceiver
metadata.technology_reasoning: The capacitive soil moisture sensor probe is the industry-standard type for accurate soil moisture measurement due to its corrosion resistance and durability versus resistive probes. Integration of an MCU and radio transceiver is common in smart agriculture sensors for data processing and wireless communication, dominating the market for IoT-enabled soil monitoring solutions.

components.reasoning: This is the core functional component detecting soil moisture levels through capacitance changes and is always present as a separate sensing unit.
The MCU processes sensor data and executes firmware; it is typically a discrete, procured semiconductor module integrated in the sensor assembly.
Enables wireless transmission of sensor data via common protocols (e.g., LoRa, Zigbee, BLE), and is a separate module in most smart soil moisture sensor designs.
Provides protective structural support and environmental sealing for the sensing elements and electronics; typically manufactured as a distinct component.
Serves as the platform for mounting the sensing element, MCU, radio module, and other electronics; usually procured or manufactured as a standardized board.

components.component: Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy Harvester)
components.reasoning: Supplies electrical power for sensor operation; commonly a replaceable or rechargeable battery pack or integrated energy harvesting device in wireless sensors.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Element.name: Silicon
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Element.reasoning: Used as the semiconductor substrate material for capacitive sensing elements due to its semiconductor properties and ubiquity in sensor fabrication. Absolutely essential as the sensing function relies on silicon-based microfabrication.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Element.name: Aluminum oxide
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Element.reasoning: Commonly used as a dielectric layer or passivation coating to electrically isolate sensing electrodes, providing stability and corrosion resistance. Industry standard coating material rarely substituted.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Element.name: Copper
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Element.reasoning: Used for conductive electrodes and wiring due to high electrical conductivity and good manufacturability, essential for capacitive sensing circuits.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Element.name: Epoxy resins
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Element.reasoning: Typically used as encapsulants or protective coatings to protect sensitive elements from moisture and mechanical damage, common polymer with alternatives existing but widely used.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Silicon
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Core semiconductor material for integrated circuit fabrication, absolutely essential to all microcontrollers.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Copper
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Used for chip interconnects and internal wiring due to excellent electrical conductivity, industry standard.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Aluminum
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Used in some chip metallization layers and packaging components, standard material though copper increasingly dominant.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Epoxy resins
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Used in packaging and encapsulation materials to protect the IC chip, industry standard polymer for MCU packaging.

Radio Transceiver Module.name: Silicon
Radio Transceiver Module.reasoning: Semiconductor base material for RF ICs and transceiver chips, essential for operation.

Radio Transceiver Module.name: Gallium arsenide
Radio Transceiver Module.reasoning: Often used for RF front-end semiconductor components for better high-frequency performance, common in radio modules though some use pure silicon solutions.

Radio Transceiver Module.name: Copper
Radio Transceiver Module.reasoning: Used for circuit interconnects, antenna traces, and internal wiring due to excellent conductivity.

Radio Transceiver Module.name: Aluminum
Radio Transceiver Module.reasoning: Used in various shielding, antennas, or packaging elements for weight and conductivity reasons.

Radio Transceiver Module.name: Epoxy resins
Radio Transceiver Module.reasoning: Encapsulation and PCB substrate binder materials, widely used but some alternatives exist.

Sensor Probe Housing/Enclosure.name: Polypropylene
Sensor Probe Housing/Enclosure.reasoning: Widely used polymer for sensor housings due to water resistance, chemical stability, and durability.

Sensor Probe Housing/Enclosure.name: Polyethylene
Sensor Probe Housing/Enclosure.reasoning: Common plastic used for housing in some sensor probes due to chemical resistance, though polypropylene is often preferred.

Sensor Probe Housing/Enclosure.name: Aluminum
Sensor Probe Housing/Enclosure.reasoning: Sometimes used for metallic housings for durability and EMI shielding, alternatives exist with plastics more common.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB).name: Fiberglass
Printed Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Primary reinforcing material for PCB substrates (e.g., FR4), widely used industry standard providing mechanical strength and electrical insulation.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB).name: Epoxy resins
Printed Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Binding polymer matrix for PCB laminates, essential for mechanical stability and insulation with glass fiber.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB).name: Copper
Printed Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Essential conductor material for PCB traces and pads, universal across all PCBs.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB).name: Gold
Printed Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Used in small amounts for surface plating on connectors and contacts for corrosion resistance, common but alternatives like nickel exist.

Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.name: Lithium
Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.reasoning: Critical active material for lithium-ion batteries commonly used as power sources in sensor systems, absolutely essential where lithium batteries are used.

Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.name: Copper
Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.reasoning: Used as current collectors and internal wiring in battery cells, universally required in battery design.

Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.name: Aluminum
Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.reasoning: Cathode current collector and casing material in many batteries, industry standard though alternatives exist.

Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.name: Graphite
Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.reasoning: Common anode material in lithium-ion batteries, critical for lithium intercalation.

Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.name: Epoxy resins
Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.reasoning: Used as encapsulants or potting materials in battery packs or energy harvesting modules for protection and mechanical stability, common but substitutable.
